subject.title: [codex] fix(feishu): preserve post markdown line breaks

question: Which Feishu newline-fix branch should become canonical after descriptor/runtime chunking and live-proof requirements are satisfied?
rationale: Several external PRs target the same open Feishu bug, this branch is dirty and proof-limited, and maintainers should choose one permanent branch shape rather than letting automation pick among conflicting candidates.

options.title: Repair and prove one canonical branch
options.body: Make one branch canonical only after it handles descriptor/runtime chunking, has redacted live Feishu proof, and is merge-clean; then close duplicates after preserving any uniquely useful tests.

options.title: Keep this draft as the candidate
options.body: Require this author or a maintainer to rebase, fix the channel descriptor chunking gap, undraft, and add live Feishu proof before merge.

options.title: Adopt a stronger sibling
options.body: If a sibling PR becomes merge-clean and already covers the same source paths with stronger live proof, use that branch as the landing candidate instead.

recommendation.title: Repair and prove one canonical branch
recommendation.body: Make one branch canonical only after it handles descriptor/runtime chunking, has redacted live Feishu proof, and is merge-clean; then close duplicates after preserving any uniquely useful tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The package and manifest identify m1heng as the Feishu/Lark plugin community owner, so this is the closest owner signal for choosing the permanent channel behavior.
